light.title: Lighting
light.tip.enabled.title: Match scene lighting
light.tip.enabled.what: Lights each emoji like the faces around it: shading, brightness and the colour of the light.
light.tip.enabled.ends: Off: plain emoji, as on a keyboard.
light.tip.light_colour.title: Light colour
light.tip.light_colour.what: The colour of the light falling on the emoji.
light.tip.light_colour.ends: Follow the scene: it changes with the scene's light, frame by frame. Fixed: one colour you pick, for the whole clip.
light.tip.lc_follow.title: Follow the scene
light.tip.lc_follow.what: The light colour changes with the scene, frame by frame, estimated from its brightest areas. The dot shows this frame's.
light.tip.lc_follow.ends: It can differ from the light on one particular face: if it looks wrong, switch to Fixed.
light.tip.lc_fixed.title: Fixed
light.tip.lc_fixed.what: One light colour for the whole clip. Brightness and direction still follow the scene.
light.tip.lc_fixed.ends: Drag on the wheel to pick it; the centre is white light (double-click to go back there).
light.tip.mix.title: Strength
light.tip.mix.what: How much of the scene's lighting reaches the emoji: its shading, brightness and light colour.
light.tip.mix.ends: 100%: fully lit like the faces around it. 0%: the plain emoji. Doesn't change how colourful the emoji itself is (that's Saturation).
light.tip.level.title: Brightness
light.tip.level.what: Brighter or darker than the estimate.
light.tip.level.ends: 1.00: as bright as a white card would be in this scene.
light.tip.ramp.title: Direction
light.tip.ramp.what: How much brighter one side of the emoji is than the other, following which side of the face is lit.
light.tip.amb.title: Ambient
light.tip.amb.what: Soft fill light from all around, so the shaded side isn't black. Its colour follows the scene.
light.tip.saturation.title: Saturation
light.tip.saturation.what: How colourful the emoji's own colours are, before any lighting. Turn it down for black-and-white or faded footage.
light.tip.saturation.ends: 100%: the emoji as drawn. 0%: gray (the light colour can still tint it, e.g. sepia).
light.tip.black.title: Black level
light.tip.black.what: How far the emoji's darkest parts are lifted to the footage's darkest gray. Old film and hazy footage are never fully black.
light.tip.black.ends: 100%: matches the footage. 0%: emoji keep true black.
light.tip.shutter.title: Motion blur
light.tip.shutter.what: Smears the emoji along its movement, the way the camera smears moving faces.
light.tip.shutter.ends: 1.00: one frame's worth of movement. 0: sharp.
light.tip.grain.title: Grain
light.tip.grain.what: Adds the footage's own noise to the emoji in the export, so it doesn't look pasted on.

decisions.outside: · this page belongs to the app's Decisions step
decisions.intro: Every face we find is covered. These are the boxes we weren't sure about. Anything you leave unanswered stays covered.
decisions.q.same: Is the green box the same person as the grey one?
decisions.q.overlap: Is the green box part of the grey box's face?
decisions.q.face: Is the green box a face?
decisions.note.face: Answer for what the green box is on while it plays. If it's on a face at any moment, answer Yes: No uncovers it the whole time.
decisions.note.same: Either box may show any part of their head: face, side, back or hair. It's the same person if it's the same head.
decisions.note.overlap: Answer for what the green box is on while it plays. Not a face at all only if it never is: a hand, clothes or the background. Not a face uncovers it the whole time.
decisions.note.whose: Pick the person it is, most alike first (faces, then bodies, then who was nearest). If it's nobody here, Someone new.
decisions.a.not_face_at_all: No, not a face at all
decisions.short.overlap: Part of the grey box's face?
decisions.short.same: Same person as the grey box?
decisions.why.fragment: A short stretch, too brief to count as a person, right where they are
decisions.why.same: Never on screen together; they move, look and dress alike
decisions.why.track: On screen {s} s, but rarely looks clearly like a face
